clips.title: The story
paras: Grif Wildheart is a seasoned dwarven hunter trainer stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Renowned among the local mountaineers for his deep affinity with wildlife, he instructs budding marksmen in tracking, marksmanship, and the rites of beast taming. For young hunters emerging from Coldridge Valley, Grif provides the vital bridge between firing a rifle and walking alongside a loyal animal companion.

While many Ironforge dwarves prefer the fiery warmth of a forge or the steady clink of pickaxes, Grif Wildheart has dedicated his life entirely to the frozen wilderness of Dun Morogh. Local mountaineers half-jokingly say he spends a bit too much time with four-legged beasts, but none dispute his mastery of the wild. Having spent years tracking across snowbound ridges alongside seasoned hunting companions, Grif possesses an intimate understanding of the natural predators that roam the crags.

When young dwarf hunters finish their preliminary trials in Coldridge Valley, they are directed straight to Kharanos to seek Grif's guidance. While he sharpens their aim and teaches essential wilderness survival tricks, his true specialty lies in forging bonds between hunter and beast. Through a sequence of rigorous trials, Grif sends his pupils out into the freezing wastes with a taming rod to test their mettle against Dun Morogh's iconic predators: Large Crag Boars, Snow Leopards, and Ice Claw Bears.

Once a hunter demonstrates the will and composure needed to calm three distinct wild beasts, Grif's tutelage in Kharanos reaches its conclusion. Recognizing that a hunter must also learn to feed, discipline, and train their new ally, he sends his graduates up the mountainside to Ironforge. There, under the great vaulted roofs of the dwarven capital, novice hunters report to master beast trainers to learn the deeper art of caring for their permanent lifelong companion.
